tools.name: search
tools.description: Find up to 20 relevant bibliographic records using keywords or identifiers; use fetch with a returned ID for complete public metadata. This bounded discovery list is not an exhaustive export. Use get_dataset_downloads for the entire catalogue.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve the public metadata document for one search ID, with source links, publication status and citation. The document is bibliographic metadata, not the publisher full text or abstract.

tools.name: search_publications
tools.description: Search public publications, preprints and trial-registration records with explicit filters, total counts and pagination. Query and author are keyword searches; journal/topic/source/status filters use stored labels. Preserve distinct IDs. For exhaustive or reproducible analysis use get_dataset_downlo

tools.name: search_trials
tools.description: Find registered clinical trials by keywords or exact country, sponsor, phase, condition or registry status. Returns bounded pages and registry observation dates. Registry statements and recruitment status are not completed treatment results; this collection overlaps trial records in publication sear

tools.name: get_citation
tools.description: Retrieve citation text, BibTeX and RIS for one visible record ID. Retains preprint/registration status. Check the original source before citing.

tools.name: get_citation_relationships
tools.description: Return a bounded set of explicit reference DOIs and indexed citing records for a visible record ID. These source-derived links are incomplete and are not proof of scientific support, criticism or trial/result identity.

tools.name: get_study_relationships
tools.description: Read selected source-checked links between registrations, protocols, preprints, primary reports and follow-up analyses. Provide a visible record ID to inspect its families, or omit it for the small reviewed catalogue. Includes exact DOI/NCT identities, report roles, source URLs, check dates and limi

tools.name: get_annual_statistics
tools.description: Retrieve catalogue-wide annual/status counts, missing-year totals, UTC generation time and source revision. No filters. Counts are indexed records, not independent studies or participants; current-year coverage is partial.

tools.name: get_dataset_downloads
tools.description: Retrieve the current completed dataset manifest with exact download URLs, SHA-256 checksums, byte sizes, count, UTC and source revision. Use for full SQLite/CSV/JSON, compressed SQLite-XZ, RDS-XZ data frames, citations, ZIP, compact JSON, titles/years TXT or frozen statistics. Check complete and is_

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
